services.desc: Through a shared lens of layered abstraction, dubious subject matter and spontaneous application; Subject//Scrawling invites you to squint, take two steps back, one step forward and look closely at your material associations. March 1 - April 28, 2024Celebrating the little things in life with a salon-style group exhibit featuring 51 artists and more than 170 artworks. Featured artists: Damon A., Mika Altidor, Jenny Beers, Caroline Bennett, Bill Cifuni, Hunter Coleman, Lynne Cullen, Madelene Cyr, Jill Dalton, Chris Eaton, Sarah Ford, Anne Freedman, Katherine Gerwig, Robin Gleeson-Warren, Roe Goldman, Tim Greenway, Megan Grumbling, Jana Heckerman, Lynne Herman (Feral Apparel), Bevin Holmberg,
